svg.title: Aria low-level feature architecture
svg.desc: A source-mapped architecture poster showing Aria channel ingress, FastAPI routes, orchestration and runtime internals, six feature flows, persistence, and external services.
svg.text: Inside Aria: routes, runtime, and feature flows
Low-level map of the current repository. Solid arrows show request/data flow; dashed lines show shared dependencies.

g.text: Voice capture is a separate local surface
Adapter parses event, applies channel checks,
Webhook API key checked before dispatch
WhatsApp container is Compose profile: whatsapp

svg.text: 03 · SIX FEATURE FLOWS · ROUTE → IMPLEMENTATION → STATE / EFFECT

g.text: Tool exists when admin key is set
No action executes at request time
Decision is recorded; no executor attached
In-memory index refreshes from file signature
Docs content treated as untrusted input
DRAFT → ISOLATED TEST → INDEPENDENT REVIEW → OWNER APPROVAL → RUNTIME REGISTRY
Hash mismatch or failed checks blocks approval
Registry refreshes for future agent runs
Code changes use separate proposal + reviewer; review does not apply patches

svg.text: 05 · SHARED STATE, CONFIGURATION, AND RUNTIME SERVICES

g.text: No prompt text exported as OTel attributes
Audit retains detailed event payloads locally
Attic MCP optional: remember / recall / health
Workspace mounted at configured agent path

svg.text: Configuration entry: services/agent-core/src/agent_core/config.py + environment variables · secrets intentionally omitted.
Source folders shown: services/agent-core/src/agent_core/{integrations,memory,tooling,skills,prompts} · routes are registered in main.py.
